lines.text: I'll binge-watch this show all weekend.

data.define: To watch several episodes of a show one after another.

example.text: I'll binge-watch this show all weekend.

data.l1_hook: Akhir pekan hujan. Seluruh musim. Ayo 'binge-watch'!
data.l1_ex: Aku akan \"binge-watch\" acara ini sepanjang akhir pekan.

native.tip: “binge-watch” = maraton menonton. Contoh: “I'll binge-watch this show all weekend.”
